__doc__: Autonomous acceptance (design/README.md §37). enabled=true: a verified successful run's In Review is auto-promoted to Done by the control plane. Exceptions stay in In Review for a human: hold_labels on the issue, hold_title_prefixes at the start of the title, or a `review=human` directive in the description/comments (newest wins; `review=auto` overrides labels/prefixes for one issue). Unparseable config fails closed (auto-accept disabled).
